left.en: The three friends find a map!

right.en: The monarch butterfly knows the way.
right.es-MX: La mariposa monarca sabe el camino.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya kneel around an old paper map on the grass, pointing; on the right a monarch butterfly flies over hills and fields on its long trip, in the same pointing-ahead direction. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a hill band through the middle, a lawn band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: A tartaruga-marinha tem bússola por dentro.
right.en: Sea turtles have a compass inside.
right.es-MX: La tortuga marina trae brújula por dentro.

spreads.scene: On the left Maya holds a toy compass out in front while Nuna and Theo look over her shoulders; on the right a sea turtle swims straight ahead across the open sea, in the same heading-forward pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, an open sea band through the middle, a lawn and deep water band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: A formiga segue a trilha de cheiro.
right.en: The ant follows a scent trail.
right.es-MX: La hormiga sigue un caminito de olor.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya walk in a line looking down at footprints on a dirt path; on the right a line of ants follows an invisible trail along the ground, in the same follow-the-path line. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a bush band through the middle, a dirt path band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Pé na pedra, pé na pedra!
left.es-MX: ¡Pie en la piedra, pie en la piedra!

right.pt-BR: O basilisco corre por cima da água!
right.en: The basilisk lizard runs on water!

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya step from stone to stone across a tiny shallow stream, arms out for balance; on the right a basilisk lizard runs upright across the surface of a stream, in the same stepping run. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a leafy bank band through the middle, a shallow stream band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: A aranha tem uma portinha secreta.
right.en: The trapdoor spider has a secret door.
right.es-MX: La araña tiene una puertita secreta.

spreads.scene: On the left Theo lifts a little wooden hatch in the ground while Nuna and Maya peek in; on the right a small trapdoor spider peeks out from under a round lid of soil it made, in the same lifting pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a hedge band through the middle, a garden soil band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três cavam com a pá.

right.pt-BR: O texugo cava muito mais rápido.
right.es-MX: El tejón escarba mucho más rápido.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya dig with small shovels, dirt flying behind them; on the right a badger digs fast with its strong front claws, dirt flying behind it, in the same digging pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a meadow band through the middle, a soil band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Os três abrem o baú: crec!
left.en: The three crack open the chest!

right.pt-BR: O macaco-prego quebra coco com pedra.
right.en: The capuchin cracks nuts with a stone.
right.es-MX: El capuchino rompe nueces con piedras.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya pry open the lid of a small wooden treasure chest together; on the right a capuchin monkey lifts a stone and cracks open a nut on a flat rock, in the same cracking pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a palm and rock band through the middle, a soil and flat rock band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: Os bonobos também dividem a comida.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya sit in a circle handing out shells and buttons from the chest; on the right three bonobos sit together in the forest handing fruit to one another, in the same sharing circle. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a forest band through the middle, a lawn and forest floor band along the bottom.

left.es-MX: Los tres se llenan los bolsillos.

right.pt-BR: A canguru guarda o filhote no bolso.
right.en: The kangaroo keeps her joey in a pocket.
right.es-MX: Mamá canguro tiene bolsa para su cría.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya tuck treasures into their front pockets, patting them; on the right a kangaroo stands with her joey peeking out of her pouch, in the same pocket-patting pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, a gum tree band through the middle, a dry grass band along the bottom.

left.pt-BR: Maya guarda um pouco para depois.
left.es-MX: Maya guarda un poco para después.

right.pt-BR: O gaio esconde bolotas para depois.
right.en: The jay hides acorns for later.

spreads.scene: On the left Maya tucks one shell into a hole under a tree root while Nuna and Theo keep watch; on the right a jay pushes an acorn into a hole in the ground under a tree, in the same tucking pose. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a sky band across the top, an oak tree band through the middle, a root and ground band along the bottom.

left.en: The three rest in a pile.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya lie in a tired, happy pile under a tree; on the right a family of lions rests together in a heap under a tree on the savanna, in the same happy pile. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a late afternoon sky band across the top, a tree band through the middle, a grass band along the bottom.

right.pt-BR: O polvo dorme na toca com conchas.
right.en: The octopus sleeps in a den of shells.
right.es-MX: El pulpo duerme en su cueva de conchas.

spreads.scene: On the left Nuna, Theo and Maya sleep side by side with the little treasure chest beside them; on the right an octopus sleeps curled in its den with shells piled around it, in the same curled sleep. A clear strip of empty ground separates the two halves at the center. Three horizontal bands: a night sky band across the top, a window and rock band through the middle, a bed and seabed band along the bottom.

cover_scene: Nuna, Theo, and Maya stand side by side, smiling at the viewer, with a monarch butterfly, a badger, and a kangaroo positioned around them, all facing the children. The background is a calm, open sky at the top, a band of distant trees in the middle, and a grassy field at the bottom.
